request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Recolour only two things. The driver's yellow skin (face, ears, hands) becomes a mid-tone olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows; not yellow. The red rings on the wheel hubs become rusted iron, colour #8a4a2a. Do not touch his eyes, grin, goggles or cap. Keep everything else exactly the same: the grey scrap metal body with its rust and the hazard striped panel, the ram, wheels, exhaust and soot cloud, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
